name: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.
moat_justification: Dominant, regulation-embedded position in proxy/investor communications and mission-critical trade processing with high operational and regulatory switching costs and proven through-cycle compounding — but contested by in-house operations and many vendors, exposed to financial-services volumes, and facing a print-to-digital shift.
fragility_flags: OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Strong-moat (7/10) financial-infrastructure compounder, but at $174.11 it prices in the bull case — weighted IRR 10.67%, IV@15% $108.36 vs $174.11 price; clears 15% only at or below ~$108.
moat_for: Dominant scale in proxy processing and investor communications — de facto standard workflow
Mission-critical, regulated workflows with high operational/regulatory switching costs
Large recurring-revenue base — fiscal 2026 recurring revenues grew 8%, closed sales $305M
Proven durability — revenue CAGR 8.41% over 5 years, OE positive 5/5 years
Embedded with the 15 largest U.S. wealth providers and 22 of 26 U.S. primary dealers (10-K)
moat_against: Competition from clients' in-house operations, transfer agents, proxy firms and many tech vendors
Customer base concentrated in financial services; largest client a high-single-digit share of revenue
SEC electronic-default shift could erode print/distribution economics
Event-driven and position-count revenues are cyclical with equity markets and volumes
Net debt 2.73x normalized owner's earnings limits flexibility if volumes fall
